title: 법원청사건축심의위원회규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Secretary and Clerks)
(1) The Committee shall have several secretaries and clerks, who shall be designated by the chairperson from among employees of the National Court Administration.
(2) A secretary shall, under the orders of the chairperson, prepare agenda items for deliberation and handle the administrative affairs of the Committee, and may attend and speak at meetings.
(3) A clerk shall, under the orders of the chairperson, handle distribution of agenda items, preparation of minutes, compilation of Committee-related documents, and other necessary affairs.
